effectsSummary: 5-MeO-DMT 是一种极强的迷幻剂。即使低剂量也能产生强烈的视觉和听觉幻觉、时间感知改变和自我消解。
dosageRemark: [TBT] MeO-DMT must be dosed very carefully, as even a few milligrams more can cause a very intense and unpleasant effect, which can result in psychological and mental problems lasting several weeks.
generalRisks: 血压和心率极剧升高。惊恐发作和心理困扰的风险。
longtermRisks: [TBT] Permanent disturbances in self- and reality recognition are possible. The view of the world can be permanently called into question, which can make it difficult to cope with everyday life. Latent (hidden) psychoses can be triggered.
saferUse: 5-MeO-DMT 可能在心理上难以承受。必须有陪护人。
